segments.name: ZCITY Platform
segments.description: Payment processing and e-commerce operations through the ZCITY App, offering consumers and merchants rebates, cashback and e-payments.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments: (i) payment processing and e-commerce operation on its ZCITY platform, and (ii) customized software development service.

segments.name: Customized Software development service
segments.description: Designs and develops customized software for customers under software development agreements.
segments.evidence: During the year ended June 30, 2025, the Company introduced a new revenue stream through customized software development services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for customized software development and for sales on the ZCITY platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable include money due from sales of software development, and sales of health care products on its ZCITY platform.

changes.text: In 2025, customized software development services became a second reportable segment alongside the ZCITY Platform.
changes.evidence: During the year ended June 30, 2025, the Company introduced a new revenue stream through customized software development services.
